Demiurges wiki

Demiurges is a fan-made engine for Etherlords (2001) and Etherlords II (2003). It plays the games from the files of your own copy, with newly written combat, campaign, interface and rendering code that follows the original rules. This wiki explains how to set it up and how to play.

Demiurges contains no game content. You need your own copy of the game you want to play. The GOG editions are the tested ones.

Getting started

  • Installing the game files: the game folder, the GOG installer or a data pack.
  • Playing in the browser: nothing to install, and your files stay on your device.
  • Main menu, saves and settings: switching games and where saves are kept.

Playing

  • Controls: mouse, keyboard and touch.
  • Options: the original options and the remake's own settings.
  • The adventure map: heroes, resources, buildings and turns.

Combat

  • How a battle works: heroes, health, mana and spells.
  • Turn and phases: the order of a turn.
  • Attack and defence: attackers, blockers and damage.
  • Creature abilities: the most common abilities.
  • Automatic combat and the camera.
